clearedSpotChecks.check: Which Monad release the validators and the public endpoint run on 2026-11-26, and whether the harness sources match those releases.
clearedSpotChecks.note: Fetched in this session: the v0.16.7 page says its instructions are only applicable to testnet, and the v0.16.5 page says they apply to both mainnet and testnet. web3_clientVersion on https://rpc.monad.xyz returned Monad/0.16.7. eth_getCode of 0x188d586ddcf52439676ca21a244753fa19f9ea8e at latest returned 24,009 bytes with sha256 288b97729c9e4f346195d6d31cf7d1edf5eb13b352d538b338b2df0d85a7b0d3, which matches the prefix the item cites. The item does not mention the v0.16.6 page, which exists, says the version can be skipped and is a rolling upgrade on top of v0.16.5, and states no network scope. A validator that installed v0.16.6 runs code between the two tested tags; v0.16.7 is a rolling upgrade on top of v0.16.6, so its sources include v0.16.6's changes, and the two tested ends gave identical results. This is a small gap in the release list and does not change the conclusion.

clearedSpotChecks.check: IR blocks of the compiled PoolManager never entered by any run (task 4), in particular the SELFBALANCE site 15022-15025.
clearedSpotChecks.note: src/types/Currency.sol:90-95 reads address(this).balance only when currency.isAddressZero(). Its only callers in production code are src/PoolManager.sol:285 (sync, inside the else branch of the isAddressZero test at line 281) and src/PoolManager.sol:359 (_settle, inside the else branch of the isAddressZero test at line 355, where the synced currency comes from tload at src/libraries/CurrencyReserves.sol:15-18). Both callers have already excluded currency zero, so the native branch of balanceOfSelf is dead in the deployed build. The native settle path uses msg.value (src/PoolManager.sol:356) and never reads SELFBALANCE.

clearedSpotChecks.check: Task 3: the mulDivRoundingUp branch of getNextSqrtPriceFromAmount1RoundingDown (src/libraries/SqrtPriceMath.sol:102-106) cannot be reached by an ordinary account in a successful transaction.
clearedSpotChecks.note: The branch needs amount > type(uint160).max on the output side (src/libraries/SqrtPriceMath.sol:102-106). It is called only when an exact-output step stops short of its target, so the step's amountOut is close to amountSpecifiedRemaining and exceeds 2^160. src/libraries/Pool.sol:371-373 subtracts step.amountOut from the remaining amount, and src/libraries/Pool.sol:453-460 casts (params.amountSpecified - amountSpecifiedRemaining) and amountCalculated with toInt128, which reverts for any value above 2^127. Any swap whose value passes through this branch therefore reverts, which matches the SafeCastOverflow result of the injected-state runs. The wording about deposits being capped is a side point; the int128 cast on the swap delta is what makes the branch's result unable to reach a successful transaction.

leads.question: Does any Monad mainnet validator run v0.16.6, and do the VM sources under category/vm at v0.16.6 equal those at v0.16.5 or v0.16.7?
leads.why: https://docs.monad.xyz/node-ops/upgrade-instructions/v0.16.6 exists, states no network scope and was not listed by this unit; the gap is small because both neighbouring tags gave identical results.
